facts.activity_file: isolating and depressuring a leaking system
facts.activity_series: responding to a loss of containment
facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: preventive action - alarm setpoint on TK-7104

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip had been bypassed, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip on TK-7104 and PSV-7104 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in responding to a loss of containment, specifically isolating and depressuring a leaking system. TK-7104 (product storage tanks) is in service for export product storage. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip had been bypassed. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 17 December 2014 a corrective action on TK-7104 and PSV-7104 at Cape Verity Export Terminal was reviewed against the critical safeguard it was raised to restore.
